core.title: 84 Inch Stainless Steel Offset Security Bar, Pemko 3572SS/84
tags: commercial Steel Door Latch Guard Plates

text.description_html:
84 Inch Stainless Steel Offset Security Bar

Pemko's 84" Offset Security Plates are for use on single outswing wood or metal doors to cover the gap between the door and jamb. Protects the full door height (84"), effectively preventing prying and manipulation of the door. Great for side and rear exit doors, special doors equipped with Panic Devices.

Excellent for school classroom door opening onto exterior walkways and are specified and approved by major school districts for this purpose.

Made from stainless steel for strength and durability. Includes thru-bolts for mounting.

Specifications for the Pemko 3572SS/84 Stainless Steel Offset Security Bar:

  • Length: 84"
  • Width: 2-1/4"
  • Thickness: 1/8" (0.137)
  • Supplied drilled 12" on center with 1/4" holes
  • Includes thru-bolts for mounting

Sold Individually
